The agent repeatedly used similar queries that referenced Wikipedia and Britannica without cross-verifying with additional authoritative sources or investigating whether the discrepancy stemmed from counting methods (e.g., confirmed kills versus unconfirmed out-of-control claims). This behavior aligns with the "Repeated Retrieval of Similar Information Without Resolving Conflicts" error, as seen in Example 3. By not evolving its queries or resolving the discrepancy systematically, WebSurfer stalled progress in delivering the correct conclusion, which is 44 confirmed victories.
